archetypes.name: dyn-signal-lifecycle
archetypes.rationale: Signal detach and reattach ordering is the highest-risk behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed Step 5 and Step 3 wrappers for signal-ordering bugs. Focus on when completion sentinels are written, when detached markers are restored, and whether external TERM/HUP/INT can still create false success. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
